label: def:stable-nucleus
title: Stable nucleus (Skein energy minimum)
html:
Let \mathfrak{p} and \mathfrak{n} be the categorical proton and neutron (categorical proton, categorical neutron). The nucleus with Z protons and N neutrons (Z the atomic number) is the iterated Hopf link

  \mathcal{N}(Z, N)
  = 
  \underbrace{\mathfrak{p} \oplus \cdots \oplus \mathfrak{p}}_{Z}
   \oplus 
  \underbrace{\mathfrak{n} \oplus \cdots \oplus \mathfrak{n}}_{N}.

The nucleus \mathcal{N}(Z, N) is stable if (Z, N) is a critical point of the Skein binding Lagrangian \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{bind}} (Skein binding Lagrangian) under beta variation (exchange of \mathfrak{p} \leftrightarrow \mathfrak{n} at fixed A = Z + N):

  \frac{\partial \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{bind}}}{\partial Z}
  \bigg|_{A}
  = 0 .

A stable atom appends Z electrons e^- (electron):

  \mathcal{A}(Z, N)
  = 
  \mathcal{N}(Z, N)  \oplus  Z \cdot e^-,

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall. Any generic categorical or q-deformation identities drawn upon remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is specialised here.
